subject: Insurance
title: Subrogation: Getting the Money Back
description: Learn Subrogation: Getting the Money Back in one minute.

hook.text: You're hit by another driver. Your insurer pays your claim.

discovery.text: If subrogation succeeds, your insurer refunds your deductible.

twist.text: Subrogation fails when the at-fault driver has no insurance or assets.

climax.text: Subrogation is the invisible recycling system in insurance.

punchline.text: Your insurer pays you, then sues them.

quiz.question: What is subrogation?
options: An insurer recovering claim costs from the at-fault party's insurer
